mechanism: Integration of a nanocrystalline diamond (NCD) coating on the blood-contacting surfaces of the mechanical heart valve
how_it_addresses_failure: The NCD coating reduces platelet adhesion and coagulation activation by providing a biocompatible surface that mimics the natural glycocalyx, thereby reducing the risk of thrombus formation.
falsifier: Observation of increased platelet adhesion and coagulation activation on the NCD-coated surface compared to the uncoated surface.

how_it_addresses_failure: The microfluidic sensor continuously monitors the blood environment and releases anticoagulants in response to changes in platelet activity, thereby preventing thrombus formation on the mechanical heart valve.
falsifier: Observation of increased thrombus formation on the mechanical heart valve despite the presence of the microfluidic sensor and anticoagulant agents.
